$comment: Tessera Phase 0 benchmark placeholder (AD-22 / A-16 / NFR-11). Path is fixed by the architecture spine: `tests/benchmarks/memory-index.json`. Per A-16, thresholds and baseline values MUST be left null until Phase 0 establishes the real baseline on Carver's desensitized Codex fixtures (Story 1.9). Filling these in with fabricated numbers before the baseline is measured is an explicit spec violation.

fixture.$comment: Identifier for the desensitized fixture set used to establish the baseline. Filled in when Story 1.9 measures the baseline.

cold_scan.$comment: Wall time to scan a Confirmed Source from cold into a fresh Derived Index. Higher is worse.

query.$comment: P50 and P95 wall time for a keyword query against the active generation. Higher is worse.

memory.$comment: Tessera process RSS while the active generation is loaded. Higher is worse.

index_size.$comment: On-disk size of the Tessera Derived Index SQLite file (including FTS5). Higher is worse.

gate.$comment: Quality-gate policy. Phase 0 leaves the gate OPEN (no thresholds) until the baseline is measured by Story 1.9. Once thresholds are set, a regression is any metric exceeding its threshold on the same fixture, and the change must report numbers and pass the gate before entering the default build (AD-22).
